svg.title: Walk-behind pallet stacker — Göngustýrður brettastaflari
svg.desc: A narrow powered base carries a tall lifting mast, raised pallet forks and a rear control tiller.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-pallet-stacker","label_en":"Walk-behind pallet stacker","label_is":"Göngustýrður brettastaflari","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["site-logistics","pallet-handling"],"description":"A narrow powered base carries a tall lifting mast, raised pallet forks and a rear control tiller.","design_note":"A tall fork carriage and walk-behind base distinguish the stacker from both a hand pallet truck and a seated forklift.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
